The opposite left flank stays plain cream. This is a newly drawn ROTATED VIEW, not an x-flip: physical shell seams, arm hinges, moss location and service coupling must remain on the same anatomical sides of the same robot.
Four sequential wheel hub index phases (up, right, down, left); restrained travel only, arms tucked, fixed body scale, consistent wheel contacts and anatomy. Keep all four poses in a strict 2x2 grid, 1536x1536 transparent RGBA canvas. Full silhouettes and 8% alpha margins; no shadows, ground, labels, border or extra props. High-detail painted style matching image 1, only correct its physical orientation and side visibility.
